note: Project follows Linus/minimal taste: implement only what's needed now, no 'just in case' features, no over-engineering or premature abstraction.
Reuse existing helpers (fileUtils, database, roxyApi) and compose them rather than hand-rolling new disk/db logic.
Design data structures and function signatures before logic (Data Structures First); types live in src/types.ts.
Single Express process in src/index.ts defines all /api/* routes inline; static frontend served from public/. No router split, no controllers.
profileService.ts orchestrates fileUtils.ts (disk) + database.ts (Prisma); neither lower layer knows about the other. New profile ops follow this split.
ESM NodeNext: relative imports MUST use .js extension even for .ts source files (e.g. './config.js').
Prisma client output is generated/prisma (not node_modules); import from '../generated/prisma/client.js'. Don't delete without regenerating.
Profile.backupSizeInBytes is BigInt; Express has a global 'json replacer' serializing BigInt to string. Client must parse strings back for math.
Every route wraps body in try/catch, logs via console.error, returns res.status(4xx/5xx).json({error}) typed as ErrorResponse; extract message via error instanceof Error.
Routes manually validate inputs (typeof checks, path-traversal guards with path.resolve + startsWith) inline; no validation library.
All RoxyBrowser HTTP calls go through roxyApi.ts roxyGet/roxyPost helpers; responses checked for code===0 else throw with res.msg.

proxyInfo from /browser/detail is NOT valid input for /browser/mdf — it carries display-only fields (e.g. checkChannel) that mdf rejects; modifyRoxyProxy whitelists to the 8 ProxyInfo keys before sending.
Per-profile sidecar metadata (proxy/window) stored as JSON files in backup .meta/ dir (backupMeta.ts) and .run-state.json (runState.ts); SQLite holds only Profile/Tag/ProfileTag.
All env access centralized in src/config.ts; throws on missing ROXY_BROWSER_PATH at startup. Add new env vars here.
Secondary side-effects (capturing proxy meta on backup, applying proxy on restore) are wrapped in inner try/catch that logs and continues — main op never fails because of them.
After writing code run 'bun run lint' (biome, never --unsafe, fix manually) then 'bun run build' (tsc). Prisma schema edits require 'bun run prisma:migrate'.
public/app.js is vanilla JS, no framework/bundler/transpile; Tailwind via CDN + CSS vars in index.html. Edit directly. Use escapeHtml() for user content.
Never use box-shadow; use borders to define boundaries. Confirmed: app.js/index.html have zero box-shadow usages.
Never use alert()/native dialogs; use showToast(message, type) for feedback. Confirmed: zero alert() in app.js.
Full-screen layout, no body padding/margin; dense compact layouts, font-size 13px base; minimize spacing.
Colors come from CSS custom properties in :root with body.dark-mode overrides; use --accent/--danger/--success vars, not hardcoded hex, for theme-aware UI.
All async action buttons must show loading state (spinner/disabled/loading text) during the operation.
Do not create markdown docs, summaries, examples, or README files unless explicitly asked. Functional files only.
Multi-step ops that create a Roxy profile then do follow-up work (copy/restore) must roll back the created profile (deleteRoxyProfile) if a later step throws, so no empty orphan profile is left.

Backups are reusable artifacts: a backup can be restored many times; restore mints a NEW dirId and does not consume/lineage-track the backup. Restore-picker filters backup.profileId against live dirIds only.
